title: If only
goal: Make wishes and regrets with kaşki, and follow a story full of ifs.

intro.text: *Kaşki* with `-sA` is **if only**, **I wish**: *Kaşki wagtym bolsa!* (if only I had time!). For a regret about the past, use `-An bolsa`: *Kaşki ir turan bolsam!* (if only I had got up early!).

exercises.question: How do you say **if only I had time!**?

why.1: *Bardy* is a plain past: **I had time**. *Kaşki* takes `-sA`.
why.2: *Bolsun* is the wish **may it be** (*gutly bolsun*). After *kaşki*, use `-sA`: *bolsa*.

exercises.explain: *Kaşki* + *wagtym bolsa*: if only I had time.

exercises.prompt: I wish you were here too!
accept: Kaşki sen hem bu ýerde bolsaň!
Kaşki senem [bu|şu] ýerde bolsaň!
Kaşki sen hem şu ýerde bolsaň!
Kaşki [siz hem|sizem] [bu|şu] ýerde bolsaňyz!

reject.answer: Kaşki sen hem bu ýerde bolsa!
reject.why: *Bolsa* with no ending is **he** or **she**. For **you**: *bolsaň*.

exercises.explain: *Kaşki* + *bolsaň* (if you were): the person goes on *bolsa*.

exercises.en: If only I had got up early!

accept: an

reject.why: *Turdum* is **I got up**. Before *bolsam*, use the participle: *turan*.
`-sA` is already on *bolsam*. Before it, the participle: *turan bolsam*.

exercises.explain: A regret about the past: *kaşki* + `-An bolsa`: *turan bolsam*.

accept: If only it does not rain tomorrow!
If only it would not rain tomorrow!
I hope it does not rain tomorrow!
I wish it would not rain tomorrow!
Let us hope it does not rain tomorrow!

exercises.question: *Kaşki oňa aýtmadyk bolsam!* How does the speaker feel?
options: sure that they will tell him

why.1: *Kaşki* … *aýtmadyk bolsam* wishes the telling had never happened.
why.2: *Aýtmadyk bolsam* is about the past, and it is a wish, not a plan.

exercises.explain: *Aýtmadyk bolsam*: if only I hadn't told him. A regret.

exercises.prompt: If only she would come too!
If only I had known this before!
accept: Kaşki men muny öň bilen bolsam!
Kaşki muny öň bilen bolsam!
Kaşki (men) öň muny bilen bolsam!
Kaşki (men) muny öň bilsem!

reject.why: *Kaşki* doesn't take the plain past. For a regret: *bilen bolsam*.

exercises.explain: *Kaşki* + *bilen bolsam* (if I had known): a regret about the past.

accept: If only I had money, I would travel.
If only I had [some|the] money, I would [travel|go travelling|go traveling|go on a trip].
If only I had money, I would [go travelling|go traveling|go on a trip].
I wish I had (some|the) money, I would [travel|go travelling|go traveling|go on a trip].

exercises.question: *Ertir wagtym ___, saňa kömek ederin.* (If I have time tomorrow, I'll help you.)

why.1: *Bolan bolsa* is for the past: **if I had had time**.
why.2: *Bolardy* means **it would be**: it doesn't make an **if**.

exercises.explain: A real possibility tomorrow: plain `-sA`, *wagtym bolsa*, with the future *ederin*.

exercises.prompt: I hope it doesn't rain tomorrow.
accept: Umyt edýärin, ertir ýagyş ýagmaz.
Men umyt edýärin, ertir ýagyş ýagmaz.
Umyt edýärin, ýagyş ertir ýagmaz.
Kaşki ertir ýagyş ýagmasa.

exercises.text: Kaşki men hem siz bilen git___!
exercises.en: I wish I were going with you too!

accept: sem

exercises.explain: *Kaşki* + *gitsem* (if I went): a wish about now.

exercises.title: Howa maglumaty
exercises.passage:
Merjen şenbe güni dostlary bilen daga gitmek isleýärdi. Ýöne howa maglumatyna görä, şenbe güni ýagyş ýagjakdy. Eger ýagyş ýagsa, olar öýde galjakdylar; ýagmasa, irden ugrajakdylar.

Şenbe güni irden Merjen penjireden seretdi: asman açykdy, ýagyş ýokdy. Ol dostlaryna jaň etdi, ýöne olar eýýäm başga ýere gidipdiler. Merjen öýde ýalňyz galdy.

Agşam ol ökündi. Kaşki düýn dostlaryna jaň eden bolsa! Düýn jaň eden bolsa, olar bile daga giderdiler. Indiki gezek ol howa maglumatyna däl, asmana sereder.
exercises.translation: Merjen wanted to go to the mountains with her friends on Saturday. But according to the forecast, it was going to rain on Saturday. If it rained, they were going to stay at home; if it didn't, they were going to set off in the morning. On Saturday morning Merjen looked out of the window: the sky was clear and there was no rain. She called her friends, but they had already gone somewhere else. Merjen stayed at home alone. In the evening she regretted it. If only she had called her friends the day before! If she had called the day before, they would have gone to the mountains together. Next time she will look at the sky, not at the forecast.

questions.q: What were the friends going to do if it rained?
questions.explain: *Eger ýagyş ýagsa, olar öýde galjakdylar*: if it rained, they were going to stay at home.

options: not calling her friends the day before
questions.explain: *Kaşki düýn dostlaryna jaň eden bolsa!*: if only she had called them the day before.
